title: Field Investigator in Wayanad district, Kerala
jobDescription: We are looking for a dedicated and motivated Field Investigator to support community-based initiatives focused on eye care awareness, training, and research activities across Kerala. The candidate will work closely with ASHA workers, community members, and project teams to conduct training sessions, organize field activities, and assist in research and evaluation processes. The role involves coordinating community meetings, facilitating focus group discussions, collecting field data, and contributing to program implementation and monitoring. Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, the ability to work with diverse communities, and a willingness to travel extensively for fieldwork. A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Social Work (BSW/MSW) is preferred. Candidates from related fields such as Psychology, Sociology, Counseling, or Community Development may also apply. Freshers are welcome, while prior experience in social work, NGO projects, or community engagement will be an added advantage. Fluency in Malayalam and English, along with basic computer knowledge for reporting and documentation, is essential. Responsibilities Conduct training and awareness sessions for ASHA workers on eye care and community health practices Organize and coordinate community meetings, field visits, training logistics, and focus group discussions Support community development initiatives and field-based outreach activities Assist in research activities, data collection, monitoring, and program evaluations Prepare field reports, documentation, and maintain basic project records Work closely with project teams, community stakeholders, and beneficiaries Travel across Kerala for field activities and program implementation Qualifications BSW/MSW preferred Related fields like Psychology, Sociology, Counseling, and Community Development may also be considered Freshers can apply Experience in social work/NGO/community service is an advantage Malayalam and English fluency required Basic computer literacy and willingness to travel across Kerala

title: Mobile and Web Portal Developer (Rural Technologies Team)
jobDescription: We are seeking a talented and motivated Mobile and Web Portal Developer to join our AI & Digital Solutions Team. As a Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing,and maintaining user-friendly mobile applications and web portals that serve diverse user-needs. You will also contribute to integrating basic AI features to enhance the overall user experience. Your work will play a key role in building scalable, efficient, and innovative digital solutions that improve access, engagement, and service delivery. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in both mobile and web development, a foundational interest in AI technologies, and a passion for creating impactful applications. Responsibilities  Design, develop, and maintain high-performance mobile applications (iOS and Android) and responsive web portals.  Collaborate with UI/UX designers and product teams to translate designs and wireframes into functional code.  Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services to extend application functionalities.  Implement basic AI-powered features such as chatbots, recommendations, or image recognition to improve user interaction.  Optimize applications and portals for speed, scalability, and responsiveness across devices and platforms.  Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best development practices.  Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure application quality and reliability.  Stay updated on the latest trends in mobile, web development, and AI technologies.  Work closely with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.  Maintain clear and organized documentation of code, APIs, and development processes. Qualifications  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.  Proven hands-on development experience of 2 to 3 years.  Proven experience in mobile application development (React Native, Flutter, or similar) and web development (React, Angular, or similar frameworks).  Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front-end technologies.  Familiarity with backend technologies (Node.js, Python, or similar) and database management.  Basic knowledge of AI concepts such as machine learning, natural language processing, or computer vision is a plus.  Experience with integrating APIs and managing data-driven applications.  Proficiency in version control systems like Git.  Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.  Excellent communication and collaboration skills.  Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving project needs.  Knowledge of deployment processes for mobile apps and web hosting platforms.

title: STEM Educator
jobDescription: As a STEM Educator, you will play a vital role in designing and delivering hands-on STEM curricula while engaging with students, educators, and community partners. This role involves teaching, curriculum development, program coordination, and content creation to ensure our STEM initiatives remain impactful and scalable. Application Deadline: April 15, 2025 Responsibilities Develop and deliver engaging, hands-on STEM curricula covering Robotics, IoT, AI, and digital technologies. Conduct interactive training sessions for school students, managing classrooms of up to 50 learners. Build and maintain strong relationships with schools, educators, and community stakeholders to expand program reach. Oversee logistics for STEM workshops, including scheduling, resource management, and reporting. Create and manage digital content (blogs, social media posts) to enhance program visibility and engagement. Research and evaluate STEM education methodologies to contribute to program innovation and improvement. Travel across India as required to conduct training programs and workshops. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. Exceptional communication and presentation skills to effectively engage students, educators, and stakeholders. Experience in teaching, curriculum development, or hands-on STEM training. Technical expertise in electronics hardware (micro:bit, Arduino, ESP32, etc.). Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple programs and coordinate logistics. Passion for STEM education and the ability to inspire young minds in a dynamic learning environment.

title: Production Lead
jobDescription: AMMACHI Labs is at the forefront of developing immersive learning technologiesto enhance vocational and hands-on training through interactive digital simulations. We are seeking a Production Lead to oversee and drive the end-to-end content development process, ensuring timely delivery and quality execution of our digital learning solutions. Position Overview: As a Production Lead, you will be responsible for managing the production pipeline, coordinating cross-functional teams (storyboarding artists, 3D modelers, animators, developers, and instructional designers), and ensuring that all project deliverables meet high-quality standards. This role requires strong project management, team leadership, and creative problem-solving skills to streamline workflows and meet deadlines. Responsibilities 1. Filming Planning & Execution Develop a detailed filming schedule in coordination with the instructional design and production teams. Plan and organize shoot locations, equipment, lighting, and sound setup for high-quality video production. Supervise on-site filming sessions, ensuring proper execution of camera work, angles, and scene continuity. Manage team, instructors, and crew members to ensure smooth production workflow. 2. Video Editing Plan & Review Work closely with video editors and motion graphic artists to ensure footage is edited according to project requirements. Review raw footage, suggest improvements, and coordinate with editors for final refinements. Ensure colour correction, sound design, and motion graphics enhance the video quality. Oversee revision cycles and stakeholder feedback incorporation. 3. Team Coordination & Workflow Management Assign tasks and monitor progress of camera operators, video editors, and post-production staff including graphics design, 3d animators and modellers, 2d animators, etc.. Set clear milestones and deadlines for each stage of video production. Maintain efficient communication with developers, designers, and instructional teams to align video content with learning objectives. Troubleshoot production issues and ensure a smooth, timely workflow. 4. Deadline Management & Submission Ensure all videos are delivered on time according to project timelines. Track progress using production management tools (e.g., Trello, JIRA, or Asana). Submit finalized videos for review and approval, ensuring all feedback is addressed before delivery. Maintain a structured repository of video assets and backups for future reference. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Film Production, Media Studies, Digital Media, or a related field. 3-5 years of experience in video production, filming coordination, and post- production management. Proficiency in video production tools and editing software (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Final Cut Pro). Experience with graphics, 3D animation workflow and work co-ordination. Strong knowledge of camera operation, lighting techniques, and post- production workflows. Excellent team coordination and project management skills.

title: Storyboarding Artist
jobDescription: AMMACHI Labs is dedicated to developing immersive learning solutions, including Virtual Skill Labs that enhance hands-on training through interactive simulations and eLearning. We are seeking a talented Storyboarding Artist to visualize and design compelling learning experiences for our Virtual Skill Lab project. Position Overview: As a Storyboarding Artist, you will be responsible for translating instructional content into visual storyboards for video filming, instructional videos and eLearning modules. You will work closely with instructional designers, graphic artists, video editors, and developers to ensure clarity, flow, and learner engagement. Responsibilities 1. Storyboard Development Create detailed, structured storyboards that outline visual sequences for filming based on the video scripts. Develop sketches, scene layouts, and shot compositions to guide the animation teams. Ensure alignment between visual storytelling and instructional goals. 2. Collaboration with the Development Team Work closely with instructional designers to translate technical content into engaging visual narratives. Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and refine storyboards accordingly. 3. Enhancing Learner Engagement Design storyboards that emphasize clear, step-by-step skill demonstrations. Utilize visual storytelling techniques to enhance user experience and understanding. Suggest innovative approaches to make the learning experience more immersive. 4. Quality Control & Adaptation Ensure the accuracy of storyboards in representing real-world skill training. Adapt storyboards based on usability testing and learner feedback. Maintain version control and documentation of storyboard revisions. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or diploma in Animation, Visual Arts, Graphic Design, Instructional Design, or a related field. 0-2 years of experience in storyboarding for eLearning, animations, or simulations. Proficiency in storyboarding tools like Storyboard Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar software. Strong understanding of visual storytelling, scene composition, and camera angles. Basic knowledge of 3D animation workflows and Unity-based development is a plus. Preferred Skills: Familiarity with eLearning and instructional design principles. Excellent sketching skills Experience working with technical subject matter experts to translate complex concepts into visuals. Knowledge of motion graphics and animation techniques is an added advantage.

title: Junior Unity 3D Programmer
jobDescription: AMMACHI Labs specializes in developing Virtual Skill Labs (VSL) that provide hands-on skill training through immersive simulations and interactive learning environments. We are seeking a Junior Unity 3D Programmer to assist in developing game-based training modules and simulations using Unity 3D. Position Overview: As a Junior Unity 3D Programmer, you will work with senior developers, 3D artists, and instructional designers to create interactive and immersive training experiences. You will assist in implementing gameplay mechanics, UI interactions, physics-based simulations, and performance optimizations in Unity. Responsibilities 1. Unity 3D Development & Programming Develop and implement gameplay features, interactions, and UI elements in Unity. Write clean, efficient, and well-documented C# scripts for game logic and functionality. Integrate animations, physics, and AI behaviors into training simulations. 2. Performance Optimization & Debugging Optimize game performance for smooth real-time interactions. Identify and fix bugs, glitches, and performance issues in Unity projects. mplement best practices for memory management and code efficiency. 3. Collaboration & Asset Integration Work closely with 3D artists and animators to integrate assets into Unity. Collaborate with UX designers to ensure smooth user interactions and workflows. Assist in testing and debugging to refine user experience. 4. Version Control & Deployment Use Git, SVN, or other version control systems to manage code updates. Assist in building, packaging, and deploying Unity applications across platforms (PC, Web, VR). Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Game Development, or a related field. 0-2 years of experience in Unity development. Strong proficiency in C# programming and Unity’s API. Understanding of game physics, UI development, and object-oriented programming. Familiarity with 3D modeling, animation, and asset pipelines (Blender, Maya is a plus). Preferred Skills: Basic knowledge of Unity3D development. Experience with Unity UI and scripting for interactive interfaces. Familiarity with game AI, shaders, and physics-based simulations.

title: UI/UX Designer
jobDescription: We are seeking a highly skilled UI/UX Designer to join our team, responsible for creating intuitive and engaging user interfaces while ensuring a seamless user experience. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in designing systems, wireframing, prototyping, and working within tight deadlines. This role requires close collaboration with developers, instructional designers, and other stakeholders to ensure cohesive design solutions that meet user needs and project objectives. Work closely with instructional designers to integrate educational content into user-friendly designs. Stay updated on the latest UI/UX trends, design tools, and technologies. Key Skills: Experience with User Research, creating Personas, user flows Expertise in UI/UX design tools (Figma, Adobe suite) Experience with wireframing, prototyping, and creating design systems. Strong understanding of design principles, usability, and user-centered design. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to prioritize tasks and work efficiently under tight deadlines. Strong attention to detail and a problem-solving mindset. Qualifications Qualification: A degree in a related field such as Graphic Design, Web Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or User Experience (UX) Design Certifications: (optional) Additional certifications or specialized courses in UI/UX design if any Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing Figma expertise, user-centered approach and case studies Experience: 2 to 5 years Experience working in UI projects is important—ranging from web apps, mobile apps, dashboards, e-commerce platforms, and more.

title: Instructional Design Lead – eLearning Projects
jobDescription: AMMACHI Labs is committed to transforming education through interactive and engaging digital learning solutions. We specialise in creating eLearning experiences that combine educational excellence with innovative technology, including simulations and game-based learning. We are looking for a talented Instructional Design Lead to lead the design and development of effective eLearning content that enhances engagement and retention. Position Overview: The Instructional Design Lead will oversee the creation of high-quality eLearning projects, ensuring the instructional integrity and engagement of content for a diverse audience. This role will require expertise in instructional design principles, experience with simulations or game-based learning, and the ability to lead a team of designers, writers, and multimedia experts. The ideal candidate will have a passion for digital education, a strong background in instructional strategies, and the ability to adapt content to various learning needs. Responsibilities 1. Instructional Strategy and Curriculum Development Lead the instructional design process, including needs assessment, content analysis, and curriculum development for eLearning courses. Develop and implement instructional strategies that leverage simulation and game-based learning to create immersive, hands-on learning experiences. Design and document course outlines, learning objectives, and assessment strategies to align with the desired learning outcomes and competencies. 2. Project Leadership and Team Collaboration Oversee and manage the instructional design team, providing guidance on design best practices, content structuring, and multimedia integration. Collaborate closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), multimedia designers, and developers to translate complex concepts into engaging, user-friendly digital content. Establish project timelines, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring that instructional goals are met on time and within budget. 3. Content Development and Quality Assurance Create storyboards, scripts, and prototypes for eLearning modules, with a focus on clarity, engagement, and interactivity. Review and refine content, providing feedback on instructional quality, multimedia use, and learner engagement. Lead the testing and review process for simulations, games, and other interactive elements, ensuring instructional quality and functionality across all platforms. 4. Innovation and Learning Analytics Stay updated on the latest trends in instructional design, eLearning, and educational technology, integrating relevant advancements into project strategies. Leverage learning analytics to assess the effectiveness of eLearning modules, iterating on design approaches to improve learner outcomes. Drive the development and adoption of gamified elements, simulations, and other innovative learning formats to create immersive eLearning experiences. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Curriculum Development, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in instructional design, with a proven track record of developing engaging eLearning content. Expertise in instructional design tools such as Articulate Storyline, Captivate, or other authoring tools, with a solid understanding of SCORM/xAPI standards. Experience with simulation or game-based learning techniques, including designing for interactivity, immersion, and engagement. Strong project management skills with experience in leading cross- functional teams and meeting deadlines. Excellent communication and leadership abilities, with a collaborative approach to working with SMEs, designers, and developers. Preferred Skills: Familiarity with multimedia production tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite) and interactive learning platforms (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine). Knowledge of instructional theories and models, such as ADDIE, Bloom’s Taxonomy, and Kirkpatrick’s Levels of Evaluation. Experience in designing content for diverse audiences, including K-12, corporate training, or vocational training.

title: Audio Engineer – eLearning Content (Multilingual)
jobDescription: AMMACHI labs specialises in creating impactful eLearning content for diverse audiences across India. Our goal is to provide accessible, high-quality educational resources in multiple regional languages. We are looking for a skilled Audio Engineer to oversee the recording and editing of audio content that meets the unique needs of our multilingual learners. Position Overview: The Audio Engineer will be responsible for recording, editing, and mastering audio content for eLearning courses, ensuring clarity, consistency, and quality across all languages. This role requires an individual with a keen ear for language nuances and an understanding of the cultural significance of regional dialects. The Audio Engineer will work closely with voice artists, instructional designers, and project managers to produce professional audio content that enhances the learning experience. Responsibilities Audio Recording and Editing Set up and manage audio recording sessions, including equipment calibration, microphone placement, and sound checks, to capture high-quality voiceovers in multiple regional languages. Edit and clean audio files, removing background noise, normalising levels, and ensuring clarity and consistency across all recordings. Mix and master audio content, applying effects, filters, and sound adjustments to achieve a polished, professional sound for eLearning modules. 2. Quality Control and Multilingual Content Management Ensure all audio recordings meet quality standards, with clear enunciation, accurate pronunciation, and proper tone for each regional language. Maintain consistency in audio levels and format across various languages and modules, adhering to company guidelines for volume, pitch, and pacing. Collaborate with native speakers and language experts to verify linguistic accuracy, ensuring that audio content resonates culturally and linguistically with target audiences. 3. Project Collaboration and Coordination Work closely with instructional designers, voiceover artists, and project managers to plan recording sessions, set deadlines, and ensure timely delivery of audio files. Provide direction and feedback to voice artists on pronunciation, tone, and pacing, aligning with the educational goals and content requirements of each module. Manage and organise audio files, maintaining a systematic and accessible library of all multilingual recordings. 4. Technical Troubleshooting and Innovation Troubleshoot audio issues during recording and editing, ensuring smooth and efficient production workflows. Keep updated on audio technology and software advancements to improve the recording and editing processes. Implement best practices for remote recording, as necessary, for geographically dispersed voice artists or collaborators. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Sound Design, Music Production, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in audio recording, editing, and production, with a focus on eLearning, educational content, or voiceover work. Proficiency in audio software such as Pro Tools, Adobe Audition, Audacity, or Logic Pro, along with a solid understanding of audio hardware (microphones, mixers, audio interfaces). Strong understanding of audio requirements for eLearning, including clarity, pacing, and adaptability to various devices and environments. Experience working with regional languages (e.g., Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Kannada) and understanding of cultural nuances in voiceover for educational content. Excellent communication and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate across multiple teams and meet deadlines.

title: Game Designer
jobDescription: AMMACHI Labs is a leader in immersive learning solutions, developing Virtual Skill Labs (VSL) to provide hands-on skill training through simulations and serious games. We are looking for a Game Designer to design engaging and interactive learning experiences that integrate game mechanics with educational content. Position Overview: As a Game Designer, you will be responsible for conceptualizing and designing game-based learning experiences for skill training. You will collaborate with Unity developers, 3D artists, instructional designers, and UX teams to ensure a smooth, engaging, and effective learning journey for users. Responsibilities 1. Game Concept & Design Interact with subject matter experts, students to document the key requirements and technical details for the simulations. Develop detailed understanding of the level of the students, demographics, technographics, and create personas Develop game mechanics, rules, and progression systems for interactive learning modules, with focus on learning, and engagement. Design game levels, challenges, and feedback systems that align with training objectives. Define player interactions, objectives, and rewards to enhance engagement. Ensure the balance between educational value and fun gameplay. 2. Game Documentation & Storyboarding Create detailed Game Design Documents (GDD) outlining mechanics, UI/UX flow, and interaction models. Develop storyboards, wireframes, and prototypes for game scenarios. Collaborate with storyboarding artists and multimedia designers to visualize learning experiences. 3. Prototyping & Testing Work with UX team to create functional prototypes and iterate based on feedback. Conduct playtesting sessions to analyze user engagement and learning effectiveness. Identify and resolve gameplay, usability, and performance issues. 4. Collaboration & Implementation Coordinate with 3D artists, animators, and UI designers to ensure a seamless player experience. Provide detailed game logic documentation for developers. Integrate gamification elements such as leaderboards, badges, and progression systems. Qualifications Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Game Design, Interactive Media, or a related field. Fresher / 1-2 years of experience in game design, preferably in educational or serious games. Proficiency in Unity and game design tools like Unreal Engine, Blender, or Maya (preferred). Strong knowledge of game balancing, player psychology, and interactive storytelling. Experience with UI/UX design principles for games. Preferred Skills: Experience in game design. Familiarity with instructional design concepts for gamified learning. Understanding of scripting languages (C#, Python, or similar) for interactive elements. Familiarity with Figma and Unity3D is a plus.

Coordinate with graphics artists and animators to integrate visuals into learning modules. Maintain an organized library of raw footage, edited files, and project assets. 4. Quality Control & Delivery Review final edits to ensure accuracy, consistency, and engagement. Render and export files in appropriate formats for different platforms. Adapt videos based on stakeholder feedback and usability testing. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree/diploma in Film Editing, Multimedia, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in professional video editing. Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and Audition. Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, and transitions. Basic knowledge of motion graphics and animation is a plus. Preferred Skills: Experience in educational or instructional video editing. Knowledge of screen recording tools (Camtasia, OBS Studio, or similar).

Incorporate feedback from instructional designers and subject matter experts to refine animations. Ability to create story-driven animations for interactive learning.
